name: pilgrims-rest
scope: Versioned local expedition checkpoints, autosave and controller-operated suspension/continuation; atomic Chronicle and run-receipt persistence; damaged-save and multi-tab conflict handling; updated AAA quality roadmap and Excel production workbook. Preserves the existing archery, world, audio, Xbox, VR and AR Sanctuary.
saveCompatibility: Existing vesperfall-profile-v1 is preserved as a legacy mirror. The new vesperfall-expedition-v1 envelope atomically stores profile plus a current-generator checkpoint. Older releases had no persistent full-run checkpoint.
hardwareStatus: Software browser and emulated-controller acceptance are used for publication. Real Quest 3 controller ergonomics, comfort, audio localization and performance still require physical hardware playtesting.
